units.source_text: 几个老婆子听见室中谈话，知道事情没有成就，互相诧问：“二小姐哪里去了？

en.t: Several old women heard the conversation inside the room, realized that the matter had not succeeded, and asked one another in astonishment, "Where has the second young lady gone?

units.source_text: 有人说：“如此看来，其中必有缘故。”

en.t: Someone said, "Judging from this, there must be some reason behind it."

units.source_text: 又有一个面目可憎的老婆子，张着牙齿零落的嘴巴说：“我每次看到这位薰中纳言，

en.t: Another old woman with a hateful-looking face opened her toothless, gaping mouth and said, "Every time I see this Middle Counselor Kaoru,

units.source_text: 似觉自己脸上的皱纹也都平了。

en.t: I almost feel as if even the wrinkles on my own face have smoothed out.

units.source_text: 这样标致可爱的郎君，大小姐为什么拼命躲避他呢？

en.t: Why does the elder young lady try so desperately to avoid such a handsome and charming gentleman?

units.source_text: 说不定，像人们常常讲起的，有一个可怕的魔鬼附在她身上了！”

en.t: Perhaps, as people often say, some dreadful demon has possessed her!"

units.source_text: 另一人说：“喂，不要说这不祥的话！

en.t: Another person said, "Now, do not say such unlucky things!

units.source_text: 哪里会有魔鬼附在她身上！

en.t: There is no way a demon could have possessed her!

units.source_text: 只因我家两位小姐从小生长在远离人群的地方，关于这种事情，没有人替她们做适当的指导，因此瑟缩不前。

en.t: It is only because our two young ladies grew up from childhood in a place far from other people, and no one gave them proper guidance in matters like this, so they shrink back and hesitate.

units.source_text: 今后渐渐习惯，自然会成功的。”

en.t: Once they gradually grow used to it from now on, things will naturally work out."

units.source_text: 又有人说：“但愿大小姐快点诚心诚意地接待他，早日图个享福。”

en.t: Someone else said, "I only hope the elder young lady will soon receive him sincerely and wholeheartedly, and find happiness as early as possible."

units.source_text: 她们谈谈说说，不知不觉地都睡着了。

en.t: As they went on chatting, before they knew it they had all fallen asleep.

units.source_text: 其中也有几个人发出很难听的鼾声。

en.t: Among them, a few also began to make very unpleasant snoring sounds.
